titulo: International Paper, Oct 2023: about $292,035 of Q3 2023 net earnings per employee in the Oct 2023 plan. The math, done.
caption:
International Paper, Oct 2023: about $292,035 of Q3 2023 net earnings per employee in the Oct 2023 plan. The math, done.

On October 26, 2023, International Paper reported third-quarter 2023 net earnings of $165 million. In an 8-K filed on October 18, 2023 (event date October 17), it said it plans to permanently close its containerboard mill in Orange, Texas, a closure it expects to reduce its workforce by approximately 565 employees.

From the archive: Oct 2023. Not today's news.

The math: $165,000,000 (net earnings, third quarter 2023) ÷ approximately 565 employees = about $292,035 of third-quarter 2023 net earnings, for every employee the Orange mill closure announced in October 2023 is expected to remove. We round down.
A is Q3 2023 net earnings, reported Oct 26, 2023. B is from an 8-K filed Oct 18, 2023 (event date Oct 17). The dates differ. B is the Orange, Texas mill only: approximately 565 employees. The 8-K names other jobs we do not count. A job in a plan is not a named person.

(Our take.) As expected, they said. Here is the per-job column.

Sources

F2: International Paper Form 8-K, Items 2.05 and 2.06 (mill closure), filed Oct 18, 2023 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/51434/000119312523258136/d489478d8k.htm
